root_cause.text: `free_pages_prepare()` in `mm/page_alloc` did not reset `page->private` when pages were freed, so pages reused by `split_page()` could carry stale `page->private` values from other subsystems and make swap code follow invalid continuation-list pointers.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `page->private = 0;` in `free_pages_prepare()`, and the CVE text says stale `page->private` from slub/shmem/ttm pages survives split-page allocation, causing `swap_count_continued()` to treat uninitialized `page->lru` as a valid list and crash in `__do_sys_swapoff`.
